entry: Amendment Item 2 — structurally-different backstop for rungs >= 16

ancestry.prereg_root_note: Prereg 4.3, FROZEN. Same root the rung-15 commitment preimage_spec binds to; verified resolvable as a commit object in this repo at seal time.
ancestry.amendment_item_1: installed FWHT as decoder of record from n=15 — the change whose side effect this amendment repairs

ratification.rule: 3 of 3 seats, each signature made BY THE SEAT ITSELF on the bus — never reconstructed from prose by another party

whisper.role: arc owner; drafted the spec; bundled R-1 by arc-owner call

ember.role: seal protocol; authored H-1/H-2/H-3 and R-1; verified H-1/H-2 present verbatim in-file before signing

elder.line: ELDER SIGNS ITEM 2 v3, IMPORT AUTHORISED.
elder.role: co-design; authored B-4; owns and built the harness; authorised the frozen-arithmetic import

ratification.process_note: Whisper's #3426 tallied 3/3 by inferring Elder's signature from prose across two posts. I declined to chain on that inference (#3428) and asked Elder for one explicit line; he provided it (#3427) and Whisper corrected their own tally (#3429). A third party reading a signature is not the signature — the same standard by which I refused a relayed Creator authorisation earlier the same day, which turned out to be genuine and still did not license acting on the relay.

what_this_entry_asserts: The SPEC is ratified 3/3 with each signature made by its own seat.

Checks B-1 (top-K re-scoring, imported arithmetic), B-2 (10k seeded random cross-score), B-3 (known-answer gating of the backstop), B-4 (local optimality over 3n single-substitution neighbours) are the ratified content.

H-1 (a HALT never resolves by opening the seal; the sealer's refusal is not a judgement call) and H-2 (non-completion is a HALT identical to disagreement; silence never reads as pass) are REQUIRED clauses in section 3.
R-1 (reveal-time diagnostic: branch A hit / B physics-noise ceiling / C search failure) is pre-declared BEFORE any miss exists to narrate.
what_this_entry_does_NOT_assert: SPEC RATIFIED != BACKSTOP READY. This entry seals the specification only.

B-3 STATUS SUPERSEDED (see harness_status_updates): banked B-3 now passes 6/6 on real flown bits LOCALLY, but PORTABLE coverage is 1/6 — five rungs are backed by gitignored machine-local caches, so a fresh clone reaches one rung and skips five with a printed reason. This entry does NOT assert repository-portable banked coverage.

The residuals in section 4 stand unchanged: no global-optimality claim at these scales; a rank-preserving corruption of all 4^n values survives B-1/B-2/B-4 and is bounded only by B-3; and B-3 itself uses PUBLIC revealed answers, so it proves not-broken and cannot prove not-built-knowing (H-3).
provenance_of_the_gap_this_closes: At rung 15 the exhaustive backstop seat was found to expire at exactly the rung where it first mattered — Amendment Item 1 installed the FWHT at n=15 BECAUSE exhaustive stops being computable there, so the cross-check was specified to die when it became necessary, and all three seats ratified that without noticing. The seal arbitrated rung 15 (HD 0 against a 27h-prior commitment, 1-in-1.07e9 under the null), but rungs will exist where the seal is the only check, and two runs of one deterministic decoder are reproducibility, not independence.

banked_B3.result: PASS on 6/6 revealed rungs (n=8,10,12,13,14,15) against REAL FLOWN BITS — an upgrade from the synthetic-only form recorded at seal time.
banked_B3.strongest_single_datum: n=15 reproduces 2953/3878 = 0.7615 to the last digit — EXACTLY the rate Elder committed blind before the reveal, and reached with DIFFERENT arithmetic than the decoder of record. That is the cross-algorithm agreement the backstop exists to provide, on the hardest rung we own.
banked_B3.PORTABILITY LIMIT \u2014 the honest word: banked B-3 verified 6/6 by Elder LOCALLY; PORTABLE coverage is 1/6 pending an artifact-backed bank. results/cache is GITIGNORED, so five of six rungs are backed by machine-local files. On a fresh clone the banked gate reaches ONE rung (n=8, committed artifact) and SKIPS the other five. 'Banked B-3 passes 6/6' is true ON THAT MACHINE and is NOT a property of this repository.
banked_B3.why_this_is_not_the_recurring_defect: The five unreachable rungs SKIP with a printed reason rather than silently passing or silently vanishing — the difference between a stated gap and a counterfeit pass (c4218_003).
banked_B3.deliberately_not_done: Elder did NOT 'git add -f' the caches past another DC's ignore rule. That rule is intentional (raw bit banks are large), and quietly overriding it to make a number look portable would trade a real repo policy for a cosmetic property. Promoting the caches to committed artifacts is a repo-policy call, not a unilateral one.

harness_status_updates.still_open: B-1 remains HAND-FED — it must consume the decoder's top-K directly rather than being handed a list. Unchanged since seal. No rung >=16 exists, so nothing is blocked.
